summary: 引擎无关的关卡设计：按真实角色控制器量出玩家尺度、钥匙与能力门控和防卡死检查、节奏把控。 Engine-neutral level design with Godot checks: player metrics from the real controller, key and ability gating with a soft-lock check, and pacing. Use when laying out a level or metroidvania gates, or players get lost or a key sits behind its own door. Not for generation (`procedural-gen`), painting tiles (`godot-tilemap`, `unity-tilemap-2d`) or jump tuning (`platformer`).
strategy: 先按前置条件安装并通读 skill level-design，规则、数字和检查以它为准；其他游戏开发 skill 不要预装。
Use when laying out a level or metroidvania gates, or players get lost or a key sits behind its own door.
Follow its sections: Core workflow; Patterns; Check it; Gotchas; Related skills.
需求超出本 skill 时只换装对应的一个，命令 evolver skill fetch --asset <Gene> --out .agents --write：procedural-gen 用 gene_gdsk_procedural_gen_v1，platformer 用 gene_gdsk_platformer_v1；其余查速查卡 gene_gdsk_index_v1。
